title: Robust Bilayer Electronic Structure and Reduced Magnetic Exchange in La2SmNi2O7
title_zh: La2SmNi2O7 中稳健的双层电子结构和减少的磁交换
summary: 稀土替代提供了增强双层镍酸盐超导性的有效途径，但其对局部电子结构和磁交换相互作用的影响仍不清楚。在这里，我们报告了 La2SmNi2O7 单晶的 Ni-L₃ 边缘共振非弹性 X 射线散射 (RIXS) 测量，La2SmNi2O7 是一种 Sm 取代的双层镍酸盐，具有增强的面内晶格畸变和减小的层间 Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni 键角。
abstract: Rare-earth substitution provides an effective route to enhance superconductivity in bilayer nickelates, but its influence on the local electronic structure and magnetic exchange interactions remains unclear. Here we report Ni-L₃-edge resonant inelastic x-ray scattering (RIXS) measurements on single crystals of La₂SmNi₂O₇, a Sm-substituted bilayer nickelate with enhanced in-plane lattice distortion and a reduced interlayer Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni bond angle. Despite these structural modifications, the local electronic excitations associated with NiO₆ crystal-field and charge-transfer processes occur at essentially the same energies as in La₃Ni₂O₇, including features near 0.3~eV, 1.0~eV, and 1.5~eV. This shows that Sm substitution does not substantially alter the local NiO₆ crystal-field and charge-transfer energy scales of the corner-shared bilayer. In contrast, high-resolution RIXS reveals well-defined spin-wave-like excitations whose band top is reduced by sim7~meV. A bilayer J_c-J₁-J₂ Heisenberg analysis of the spin excitation dispersion indicates an approximately 10% reduction of the effective magnetic exchange scale, which correlates with the reduced interlayer Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni bond angle. The small intrinsic damping of these modes further points to robust local-moment-like spin dynamics in the ambient-pressure parent phase.These results reveal a dichotomy in the response to Sm substitution, with largely preserved local electronic excitation energies but a reduced magnetic exchange scale. They identify the Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni geometry as an important structural parameter influencing magnetism in Ruddlesden--Popper nickelates and provide spectroscopic constraints on microscopic models of high-T_c superconductivity in this family.

title: Study on Influence of Reaction time and process environment conditions on Heterogeneous Hydrogenation of HTPB using a Pd-Zr-charcoal catalyst
title_zh: 反应时间和工艺环境条件对Pd-Zr-炭催化剂HTPB多相加氢影响的研究
summary: 本文概述了反应器环境条件对端羟基聚丁二烯（HTPB）聚合物采用异丙醇和甲苯作为活性溶剂介质的双溶剂体系催化加氢法合成氢化HTPB（HHTPB）的影响。展示了一种新颖的合成方法，以了解各种反应器环境条件（例如氮气、氢气和氢气-空气环境）对使用由钯和锆作为贱金属组成的负载在活性炭上的催化剂氢化 HTPB 的影响。实验在 100 mL Inconel 制造的带有磁力驱动变速叶轮的间歇式反应器中进行。研究中展示了工艺时间的优化并固定为 6 小时。
abstract: This paper outlines the influence of reactor environment conditions in synthesizing hydrogenated HTPB (HHTPB) using Hydroxyl-terminated polybutadiene (HTPB) polymer by catalytic hydrogenation method using bi-solvent system using iso-propyl alcohol and toluene as active solvent media. A novel synthesis approach to understand the effect of various reactor environment conditions such as nitrogen gas, H2 gas and hydrogen-air environments to hydrogenate HTPB using a catalyst made up of palladium and zirconium as base metals supported on activated charcoal was demonstrated. Experiments were conducted in a 100 mL Inconel made batch type reactor with a magnetically driven variable speed impeller. Optimization of process time is demonstrated and fixed as 6 h for the study. HTPB and HHTPB polymers were characterized by NMR, FTIR, and chemical analysis. The results showed that the degree of hydrogenation of HTPB is ~ 87.5% which is a waxy solid under hydrogen-air environment conditions for the given reactor volume with the chosen operating conditions. After hydrogenation of HTPB, no significant change in hydroxyl value was noticed, and the HHTPB formed is of vinyl-type functional isomer in H2 environment. A marginal increase in molecular weight was observed after hydrogenation in all cases. HTPB and HHTPB were subjected to TG- DSC studies and it was found that the thermal stability of HHTPB marginally increased.

title: New high-frequency method boosts 2D material readout for next-gen quantum computers
title_zh: 新的高频方法增强了下一代量子计算机的二维材料读出
summary: 量子计算机代表了技术快速发展的下一步。使用量子比特（qubit），它们有可能比传统计算机以指数速度运行某些计算。然而，开发和微调量子计算机需要大量的重复测试。为了加速量子技术的发展，我们需要一种能够超快读取量子态的方法。
abstract: Quantum computers represent a next step in the fast-paced evolution of technology. Using quantum bits (qubits), they have the potential to run certain calculations exponentially faster than conventional computers. However, developing and fine-tuning quantum computers requires an enormous number of repetitive tests. To accelerate quantum technology development, we need a method that can read quantum states at ultrafast speeds.
